parameters.query:
SELECT 'maquina' AS tipo, codigo_legacy AS clave, id_maquina AS id
FROM public.maquinas WHERE codigo_legacy IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'referencia', legacy_id, id_referencia
FROM public.referencias WHERE legacy_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    p.fecha_inicio AS "Fecha de programación (Automatico)",
    o.codigo_ot AS "OT (Automatico)",
    cl.nombre AS "Cliente (Automatico)",
    COALESCE(m.nombre, 'Sin Máquina Asignada') AS "Maquina (Automatico)",
    r.titulo_referencia AS "Referencia (automatico)",
    COALESCE(tm_metricas.kilos_producidos, 0) AS "Kilos hechos (Automatico)",
    p.kilos AS "Kilos programados (Automatico)",
    o.cantidad_plan AS "Kilos pedidos (Automatico)",
    p.fecha_inicio AS "Inicio (Automatico)",
    p.fecha_estimada AS "Finalizacion (Automatico)",
    COALESCE(tm_metricas.tiempo_produccion_real, 0) AS "Tiempo de producción real (Automatico)",
    p.estado AS "Estado (Automatico)",
    tm_metricas.ultima_produccion AS "Ultima Producción (automático)",
    COALESCE(tm_metricas.kilos_turno_a, 0) AS "Kilos Turno A",
    COALESCE(tm_metricas.kilos_turno_b, 0) AS "Kilos Turno B",
    COALESCE(tm_metricas.kilos_turno_c, 0) AS "Kilos Turno C"
FROM public.programaciones p
LEFT JOIN public.maquinas m ON p.id_maquina = m.id_maquina
LEFT JOIN public.referencias r ON p.id_referencia = r.id_referencia
LEFT JOIN public.ordenes_trabajo o ON p.legacy_ot_id = o.legacy_id
LEFT JOIN public.clientes cl ON p.legacy_cliente_id = cl.legacy_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        legacy_programacion_id,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Productivo' THEN duracion_horas ELSE 0 END), 2) AS tiempo_produccion_real,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Productivo' THEN cantidad_kilos ELSE 0 END), 2) AS kilos_producidos,
        MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Productivo' THEN fecha_produccion END) AS ultima_produccion,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Productivo' AND turno = 'Turno 1' AND fecha_produccion = CURRENT_DATE THEN cantidad_kilos ELSE 0 END), 2) AS kilos_turno_a,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Productivo' AND turno = 'Turno 2' AND fecha_produccion = CURRENT_DATE THEN cantidad_kilos ELSE 0 END), 2) AS kilos_turno_b,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Productivo' AND turno = 'Turno 3' AND fecha_produccion = CURRENT_DATE THEN cantidad_kilos ELSE 0 END), 2) AS kilos_turno_c
    FROM public.tiempos_maquina
    WHERE legacy_programacion_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY legacy_programacion_id
) tm_metricas ON p.legacy_programacion_id = tm_metricas.legacy_programacion_id
-- Rango de tres semanas: semana pasada, actual y próxima
WHERE p.fecha_inicio >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 week')
  AND p.fecha_inicio  < (DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '2 weeks')
  AND p.fecha_inicio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.proceso, p.id_maquina, p.orden_secuencia, p.fecha_inicio;
SELECT nombre, kg_hora FROM public.maquinas WHERE kg_hora IS NOT NULL;
